book: Antiquitatum convivialium libri III (Stucki, 1582): one Latin treatise on banquets of ancient and other peoples, built as three numbered books of chapters, preceded by a dedication, nuncupatory letter, two prefaces, a chapter index and a catalogue of authors, and followed by an index of matters and an index of scripture passages.
